units.source_text: 《空穗物语》，又名《宇津保物语》，作于平安朝中期。

en.t: The Tale of the Hollow Tree, also known as The Tale of Utsuho, was written in the middle of the Heian period.

units.source_text: 大意：俊荫乘舟访中国，途遇暴风，飘泊到波斯国，遇七仙人，授以弹琴妙曲。

en.t: In outline: Toshikage travels by boat to visit China, meets a violent storm on the way, drifts to Persia, encounters seven immortals, and is taught marvelous pieces for the koto.

units.source_text: 归国后将琴技传授其外孙仲忠。

en.t: After returning home, he passes his koto skills on to his grandson Nakatoshi.
Nakatoshi falls in love with the beautiful Lady Takamiya.

units.source_text: 后来贵宫当了东宫妃子，在朝争权，等等。

en.t: Later, Takamiya becomes the Crown Prince's consort and becomes involved in struggles for power at court, and so on.
